nodes.mandatory_behavior: Compress lower-priority data with recoverable handles/provenance.
nodes.real_qualification: Compression fidelity corpus and handle hydration pass.

nodes.title: Retrieve before edit
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Material mutation requires adequate repository understanding.
nodes.real_qualification: Blind edit attempt with missing context is blocked/surfaced.

nodes.title: Context provenance
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Fragments carry source/repo/revision/hash/retrieval reason.
nodes.real_qualification: Prompt envelope validates provenance on every non-ephemeral fragment.

nodes.title: Temporal validity
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evaluate staleness/current worktree/source revision.
nodes.real_qualification: Stale cache never labeled current.

nodes.title: Context Engine as shared service/ports
nodes.mandatory_behavior: All agents/reviewers/browser/testing use same context ports.
nodes.real_qualification: Architecture test prevents duplicate search stacks in production modules.

nodes.title: Incremental large-codebase indexing
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Update lexical/symbol/semantic/graph indices incrementally.
nodes.real_qualification: Cold vs incremental index benchmarks reported.

nodes.title: Context efficiency metrics
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Measure verified outcome per token/latency/cost.
nodes.real_qualification: Benchmark dashboard reports quality and economics together.

nodes.title: Fast Context subagent
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Bounded read-only retrieval specialist can build ContextPack.
nodes.real_qualification: Specialist has no mutation tools and produces provenance-complete pack.

nodes.title: Context Inspector
nodes.mandatory_behavior: User sees what context selected/excluded and why.
nodes.real_qualification: Inspector ids match PromptEnvelope.

nodes.title: Workspace Capsule
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Portable bounded task package of context/decisions/evidence/runtime requirements.
nodes.real_qualification: Handoff verifies no authority/secret values smuggled in capsule.

nodes.title: Lazy tool/schema context
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Hydrate schemas only when relevant after discovery; authorization separate.
nodes.real_qualification: Large MCP catalog token benchmark proves lazy behavior.

nodes.title: Specialized subagents with tool/model profiles
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Agent profile selects bounded tools/model policy/domain context inside AgentExecutionCapsule.
nodes.real_qualification: Launch two real specialized children and verify independent state/tool ceilings.

nodes.title: Background subagents with follow-up continuation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Background child remains addressable/resumable; follow-up is typed and prior output treated as evidence.
nodes.real_qualification: Complete child, restart parent, send follow-up and verify lineage/state.

nodes.title: Default background delegation policy
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Background only when dependency graph says parent can progress independently; never blind default.
nodes.real_qualification: Dependency-sensitive scheduler keeps blocking child foreground and separable child background.

nodes.title: Extension-provided skills
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Import/discover portable SKILL.md packages with provenance and trust.
nodes.real_qualification: Install extension skill, validate hash, activate without capability escalation.

nodes.title: Extension-provided subagents
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Declarative agent profiles import into canonical Modbit profile schema.
nodes.real_qualification: Invalid/unsafe tool declaration is narrowed or rejected.

nodes.title: Extension context/commands/MCP resources
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Support compatible external instruction manifest/commands/skills/agents/MCP through importer, not an external-reference runtime.
nodes.real_qualification: Compatibility fixture imports and migration report labels mapped/skipped/conflicts.

nodes.title: Multimodal read_file
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Text and supported image/PDF/audio/video return typed media parts according to model capability.
nodes.real_qualification: Read actual PNG/PDF/audio/video with capable and incapable models; unsupported modality is explicit.

nodes.title: Bounded PDF text→vision fallback
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Try text extraction first; bounded page render/transcription fallback is labeled lossy/untrusted.
nodes.real_qualification: Scanned PDF fixture triggers bounded vision path; page range/source/model recorded.

nodes.title: Structured notebook read/edit
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Represent notebook cells structurally; edits target stable cell IDs and reject ambiguous/truncated state.
nodes.real_qualification: Real ipynb read/edit preserves unrelated cells and execution metadata policy.

nodes.title: Rich MCP media results
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Normalize text/image/audio/file/resource outputs into typed ToolResult media parts.
nodes.real_qualification: MCP test server returns image+text; both reach vision-capable model and evidence store.

nodes.title: Split tool media for provider compliance
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Provider adapter can transform media placement without losing semantics; canonical ModelEvent stays provider-neutral.
nodes.real_qualification: Strict OpenAI-compatible test rejects embedded media but passes split follow-up representation.

nodes.title: Model vision/agent/modalities metadata
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Capability catalog includes vision/agent and media modalities plus tool-result formatting support.
nodes.real_qualification: Routing refuses unsupported media model and selects eligible endpoint.

nodes.title: Channel image/file ingestion
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Normalize attachments to MediaEnvelope with tenant/task/source provenance; no consumer chat-product scope required.
nodes.real_qualification: Upload image/file through desktop/API and verify same canonical envelope.

nodes.title: steer / collect / followup dispatch modes
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Implement typed SteeringPolicy: interrupt-and-replace, coalesce after current, or ordered separate turns.
nodes.real_qualification: Concurrency test sends messages mid-run and verifies exact ordering/cancellation semantics.

nodes.title: Daemon multi-client HTTP+SSE event model
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Multiple clients attach to one session via replayable event stream without sharing UI-local truth.
nodes.real_qualification: Desktop + web test observe same run; reconnect from event cursor is lossless.

nodes.title: Workspace-scoped MCP transport pool
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Share healthy MCP transports by normalized config fingerprint while isolating sessions/tenants.
nodes.real_qualification: Two sessions reuse transport; config/tenant change creates separate pool entry.

nodes.title: Multi-client permission mediation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: One canonical approval owns state; clients may be designated/consensus by policy but model never resolves votes.
nodes.real_qualification: Conflicting client approvals follow configured policy and are auditable.

nodes.title: Plan/approval/worktree/sandbox feature breadth
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Covered by PlanGraph, Capability Kernel, Worktree Manager and Sandbox Gateway; do not duplicate.
nodes.real_qualification: Requirement coverage audit proves owner/test links exist.

nodes.title: Separate raw experience / persistent wiki / executable skills
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Keep immutable evaluation traces, persistent evolution knowledge and candidate skill packages as distinct stores.
nodes.real_qualification: Delete/reject candidate skill; raw traces and wiki knowledge remain intact.

nodes.title: Persistent wiki across iterations
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evolution knowledge is versioned, provenance-bound and persists independently of active skill version.
nodes.real_qualification: Rollback candidate and verify wiki head unchanged unless separately reverted.

nodes.title: Wiki Maintainer consolidation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Offline/eval worker consolidates success/failure traces into patterns; never production authority.
nodes.real_qualification: Seed contradictory traces; maintainer records both with provenance/confidence rather than overwriting.

nodes.title: Skill Proposer from wiki + traces
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Generate atomic candidate skill diffs from selected patterns/traces and explicit objective.
nodes.real_qualification: Candidate diff references motivating evidence IDs and changes one bounded behavior.

nodes.title: Validation gating and rollback
nodes.mandatory_behavior: No evolved skill becomes active until benchmark gates pass; rejected candidate is retained as evaluation artifact.
nodes.real_qualification: Candidate regressing safety/quality is rejected and previous active skill remains byte-identical.

nodes.title: Skill impact log
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Record proposal diff, source patterns, benchmark scores, disposition, model and environment.
nodes.real_qualification: Audit can reconstruct why each skill version was accepted/rejected.

nodes.title: PURPOSE / motivating knowledge linkage
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Skill metadata links purpose, assumptions and evidence without dumping wiki into runtime prompt.
nodes.real_qualification: Runtime loads purpose summary; detailed evolution wiki remains inaccessible by default.

nodes.title: Inference agent isolated from evolution wiki
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Production agent receives approved skill, not raw optimization wiki/traces unless task separately retrieves authorized evidence.
nodes.real_qualification: Prompt audit confirms evolution store is absent during normal run.

nodes.title: On-demand proposer retrieval from wiki index
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evolution agent starts with compact index/outcome summaries and hydrates specific patterns/traces.
nodes.real_qualification: Large evolution corpus stays within token budget and provenance remains complete.

nodes.title: Cross-model skill transfer evaluation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evaluate evolved skill on source and at least one distinct model family before broad promotion where economically feasible.
nodes.real_qualification: Nightly matrix reports baseline vs skill deltas per model and rejects hidden regression.

nodes.title: Skill evolution complements model scaling hypothesis
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Treat paper result as research hypothesis, not Modbit claim; measure on engineering tasks.
nodes.real_qualification: A/B benchmark uses same tasks/environment and records confidence intervals.

nodes.title: Persistent knowledge is critical hypothesis
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Run ablation without wiki/persistent evolution knowledge to justify added complexity.
nodes.real_qualification: Promotion of evolution-lab mechanism requires statistically/practically meaningful lift vs simpler skill refinement.

nodes.title: No second general memory system
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evolution wiki is scoped to Skill Lab and cannot become parallel Engineering Memory/recovery system.
nodes.real_qualification: Architecture dependency test shows production runtime has one Engineering Memory interface.

nodes.title: SKILL.md-based procedural packaging
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use portable skill documentation/resources while keeping Modbit execution policy separate.
nodes.real_qualification: Package parser validates metadata/resources and rejects malformed/oversized package.

nodes.title: Tool/skill creation with registration validation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: New tool/skill must validate schema, registry wiring and invocation path.
nodes.real_qualification: Test plugin registers, lists, invokes real effector and passes removal/reload.

nodes.title: Multi-level tests including real API call
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Qualification includes direct component, registry/integration and real external API test when integration requires it.
nodes.real_qualification: Staging integration uses real test credential and recorded safe fixture; mock-only cannot pass.

nodes.title: No fake test examples
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Examples used for evaluation must be executable/verified, not illustrative placeholders.
nodes.real_qualification: Docs/example runner executes declared examples and fails release on drift.

nodes.title: Compact skill mode / selective context
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Only task-relevant skill instructions/resources enter prompt; large references lazy-load.
nodes.real_qualification: Token benchmark compares eager package vs compiled skill projection.

nodes.title: Disable model invocation metadata
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Skill can be user-only/system-only/model-invocable according to policy.
nodes.real_qualification: Model cannot invoke a skill marked non-model-invocable.

nodes.title: Tool credentials outside tool arguments
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Required/optional secrets resolved by host, never exposed as model parameter values.
nodes.real_qualification: Schema inspection contains no API key field; secret redaction test passes.

nodes.title: Domain-specific scientific tool collection
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Do not adopt the external skill-packaging framework as a Modbit runtime dependency; only packaging/testing lessons apply.
nodes.real_qualification: Dependency/SBOM and product-scope audit show no scientific-tool runtime dependency.

nodes.title: Explicit built-in tool families
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Map file/shell/search/web/user-question/plan/task/agent/media behaviors into canonical Modbit tools, not source names.
nodes.real_qualification: Compatibility matrix has canonical owner/effect/test for each source capability.

nodes.title: Isolated coder/explore/plan subagents
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use profiles with bounded tools/context and explicit result envelopes.
nodes.real_qualification: Explore child cannot mutate; coder child mutation requires worktree/capability.

nodes.title: No nested agent for certain profiles
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Delegation depth/profile ceiling is explicit.
nodes.real_qualification: Leaf profile lacks spawn capability.

nodes.title: Resumable per-agent state
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Persist child state independent of parent transcript.
nodes.real_qualification: Restart and resume child with same lineage.

nodes.title: Background task list/output/stop
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Background operations have durable handle, status, bounded preview, full OutputRef and cancel.
nodes.real_qualification: Run long task, list/status/read full output/stop after UI restart.

nodes.title: Structured AskUserQuestion
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Typed questions/options for disambiguation when interactive surface exists; text fallback is explicit.
nodes.real_qualification: Headless run returns NEEDS_INPUT rather than hanging.

nodes.title: ReadMediaFile / media budgets
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Media reads enforce edge/byte/page/duration budgets and targeted crop/full-resolution escalation.
nodes.real_qualification: Oversized image/video is bounded; explicit crop improves targeted recognition.

nodes.title: MCP config conversational management
nodes.mandatory_behavior: UI/agent may propose config changes but host validates/trusts/authorizes.
nodes.real_qualification: Proposed MCP install cannot execute until trust/credential gates pass.

nodes.title: Marketplace trust surfaced
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Show publisher/source/signature/capabilities before activation.
nodes.real_qualification: Unsigned/untrusted extension is quarantined.

nodes.title: Lifecycle hooks
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use same typed Hook Bus; no external-reference-specific hook runtime.
nodes.real_qualification: Coverage audit maps source to existing hook conformance tests.

nodes.title: ACP editor integration
nodes.mandatory_behavior: May support ACP as optional client protocol without making editor foundational.
nodes.real_qualification: Future adapter cannot own canonical state or policy.

nodes.title: Tool output spill/pagination
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use bounded previews + full artifact reference.
nodes.real_qualification: Large-output conformance test.

nodes.title: Toolsets / capability grouping
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Group discoverable tools for projection but resolve authority in Capability Kernel.
nodes.real_qualification: Toolset enablement cannot expose denied tool.

nodes.title: Procedural skills over existing tools
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Prefer skill instructions/scripts when existing canonical tools suffice; build native tool only for precise new effector/auth/streaming need.
nodes.real_qualification: Build/buy lint requires justification for every new tool namespace.

nodes.title: Tool RPC composition / execute code
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Allow isolated code composition over governed tools.* with execution/time/output limits.
nodes.real_qualification: Script attempts unauthorized tool and is denied by same Kernel.

nodes.title: Isolated subagent delegation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use AgentExecutionCapsule and bounded delegation.
nodes.real_qualification: Existing subagent isolation E2E covers.

nodes.title: Broad terminal backends
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use replaceable local/cloud/private backends under one contract; do not adopt consumer/serverless vendors by default.
nodes.real_qualification: Backend conformance suite runs same fixture on supported backends.

nodes.title: Browser snapshot + vision tools
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Structural semantic browser remains primary; targeted vision only when required.
nodes.real_qualification: Accessible and canvas fixtures validate escalation hierarchy.

nodes.title: Session search / persistent memory
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Keep session history and curated memory distinct.
nodes.real_qualification: Raw session content never auto-promotes to Engineering Memory.

nodes.title: Cron/messaging/home automation breadth
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Modbit remains software-engineering product; broad consumer assistant integrations excluded.
nodes.real_qualification: Scope audit rejects unrelated integration package in core release.

nodes.title: Self-improving skills
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Evaluate only through evolution-lab-style trace/wiki/candidate/eval gates; no autonomous production self-modification.
nodes.real_qualification: Skill cannot self-promote without eval/promotion transaction.

nodes.title: Process-local background subagent durability limitation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Modbit improves by persisting AgentNode/protocol state so background child survives Core lifecycle.
nodes.real_qualification: Kill/restart test proves durability beyond process-local baseline.

nodes.title: Typed tool pre/execute/post pipeline
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use canonical validation/policy/execute/postprocess/evidence stages with monotonic final guards.
nodes.real_qualification: Hook tries to override deny after guard; execution remains denied.

nodes.title: Composable lifecycle registrations
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Plugins register typed reversible handlers outside Core.
nodes.real_qualification: Unload extension removes handlers without stale mutation path.

nodes.title: Profiles/bundles
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Profiles are declarative compiled config, not arbitrary runtime replacement.
nodes.real_qualification: Profile validation rejects unknown/unsafe capability expansion.

nodes.title: Durable facts vs live interception separation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Durable state remains in stores; live hooks are ephemeral control.
nodes.real_qualification: Restart loses no durable truth even though hook process resets.

nodes.title: Harness decomposition: memory/planning/capability/action
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Map to existing Memory, WorkGraph, Capability Kernel, Tool/Execution owners; no second harness graph.
nodes.real_qualification: Architecture CI blocks duplicate authority service.

nodes.title: Task-conditioned harness generation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Generate declarative profile variants only in shadow/eval initially.
nodes.real_qualification: Shadow candidate never controls production run.

nodes.title: Structured failure diagnostics
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Adaptive evaluator receives typed failure taxonomy/evidence, not raw guess.
nodes.real_qualification: Fault corpus produces stable diagnostic features.

nodes.title: Bounded repair of harness/profile
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Max two bounded profile repairs; static known-good fallback always available.
nodes.real_qualification: Third repair attempt rejected; fallback run remains functional.

nodes.title: Archive/evolution of profiles
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Version candidate profiles with benchmark outcomes and rollback.
nodes.real_qualification: Rejected candidate remains audit artifact but never active.

nodes.title: Optimize reward/latency/cost jointly
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Promotion requires correctness/safety hard gates before economics.
nodes.real_qualification: Cheap but lower-correctness profile cannot promote.

nodes.title: Hybrid exact/BM25/vector retrieval baseline
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use as external baseline class, enhanced with structural signals.
nodes.real_qualification: Run same frozen retrieval benchmark profile with and without Modbit retrieval.

nodes.title: Measure input-token reduction
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Track prompt input tokens for baseline vs treatment.
nodes.real_qualification: Benchmark report includes paired distribution/confidence.

nodes.title: Measure tool-call reduction
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Count normalized tool calls per task.
nodes.real_qualification: Same model/task/environment across variants.

nodes.title: Measure agent-time reduction
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Measure execution time separately from index build and also report cold-start total.
nodes.real_qualification: Both warm agent time and cold time-to-first-use reported.

nodes.title: Do not force retrieval tool usage in treatment
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Agent chooses tools naturally so treatment is not biased.
nodes.real_qualification: Benchmark prompts are identical except available capability profile.

nodes.title: Modbit structural advantage hypothesis
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Test AST/symbol/call/dependency/Git/test signals over hybrid-only baseline.
nodes.real_qualification: Profile A baseline, B hybrid, C structural with paired trials.

nodes.title: One primary responsible agent
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Default one primary agent owns task outcome; delegate only separable bounded work.
nodes.real_qualification: Typical task creates one primary; unnecessary swarm is not spawned.

nodes.title: Agent identity separate from persona/model
nodes.mandatory_behavior: AgentNode identity persists while model/profile may change under policy.
nodes.real_qualification: Fallback model switch preserves agent/run identity and lineage.

nodes.title: Governed Plan mode
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use mutation-disabled plan profile and risk-scaled review.
nodes.real_qualification: Existing plan-mode conformance test.

nodes.title: Persistent runs and resume
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Canonical event/protocol/checkpoint state resumes exact work.
nodes.real_qualification: Restart/resume release test.

nodes.title: Fork / rewind
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Fork/revert from canonical checkpoints with provenance.
nodes.real_qualification: Existing fork/revert test.

nodes.title: Conversation compaction
nodes.mandatory_behavior: ContextEpoch compaction over lossless state.
nodes.real_qualification: Existing compaction fidelity test.

nodes.title: Non-disruptive side question
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Side question can use bounded recent/context snapshot without mutating main task state unless explicitly applied.
nodes.real_qualification: Ask side question mid-run; main state/event cursor remains unchanged.

nodes.title: Queued prompts
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Queue/collect/follow-up semantics are explicit durable input events.
nodes.real_qualification: Multiple queued inputs preserve ordering across reconnect.

nodes.title: Background tasks
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Detached work uses durable task handles, permission ceiling, checkpoint/replay.
nodes.real_qualification: Client disconnect/restart does not lose background task.

nodes.title: Recurring goals/watch
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Host scheduler may create software-engineering runs; model never self-grants scheduling authority.
nodes.real_qualification: Future schedule survives restart and preserves principal/policy.

nodes.title: Q&A → Plan → visual review
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Risk/ambiguity may trigger clarification, plan and visual evidence review without mandatory ceremony.
nodes.real_qualification: Low-risk task skips ceremony; high-risk configured task requires plan/review.

nodes.title: Exact per-run cost accounting
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Track model/tool/verification cost per run/step.
nodes.real_qualification: Usage reconciliation test.

nodes.title: Transactional subagent admission
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Capacity, worktree/write-set, capability and child record admission commit atomically before child starts.
nodes.real_qualification: Injected failure during admission leaves no orphan child/worktree/capacity leak.

nodes.title: Prompt-cache-aware compaction
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Compaction and prompt assembly account for stable cacheable prefixes and cache invalidation.
nodes.real_qualification: Benchmark cache hits/misses and verify no stale context after fork/revert.

nodes.title: OutputRef tool pagination
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Large tool outputs return bounded preview plus durable range-addressable OutputRef.
nodes.real_qualification: 10MB+ tool result is paged without context overflow and digest matches raw output.

nodes.title: Protected-effect receipt chain
nodes.mandatory_behavior: High-risk effects produce immutable hash-linked receipt chain bound to approval/capability/call/result.
nodes.real_qualification: Tamper/delete/reorder receipt causes chain verification failure.

nodes.title: Durable terminal + replay window
nodes.mandatory_behavior: PTY/process output survives client disconnect with cursor replay/backpressure.
nodes.real_qualification: Restart desktop, replay exact terminal tail and continue input.

nodes.title: Capacity tickets
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Concurrency admission consumes explicit tenant/run resource ticket before spawn/sandbox.
nodes.real_qualification: Capacity exhaustion denies launch without partial side effects.

nodes.title: Kernel/session lease locks
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Lease/fencing prevents dual active mutation owners.
nodes.real_qualification: Two clients attempt mutation; stale lease rejected.

nodes.title: Measured context/tool-result savings
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Measure tokens/tool calls/latency saved by compaction, OutputRef and retrieval choices against baseline.
nodes.real_qualification: Paired benchmark publishes verified-outcome economics.

nodes.title: Reminder/decision engine
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Host derives actionable reminders from unresolved approvals/questions/blockers/deadlines; no second scheduler.
nodes.real_qualification: Attention item is created/cleared solely from canonical unresolved state.

nodes.title: Chromium as execution engine, not a new browser engine
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Build agent-native semantic runtime on Chromium/CDP rather than replacing web engine.
nodes.real_qualification: Modern SaaS fixture executes with standard Chromium compatibility.

nodes.title: Accessibility/DOM/CDP semantic state
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Fuse AX/DOM/layout/network state into compact model-facing page representation.
nodes.real_qualification: Accessible workflow completes without screenshot/OCR dependency.

nodes.title: Stable semantic element references
nodes.mandatory_behavior: References are scoped to browser-state version and invalidate safely on relevant change.
nodes.real_qualification: DOM mutation makes stale ref return TARGET_STALE, never click wrong element.

nodes.title: Incremental page-state deltas
nodes.mandatory_behavior: After baseline snapshot, send bounded semantic deltas when safe; full rehydrate fallback.
nodes.real_qualification: Long navigation flow shows token reduction and state equivalence.

nodes.title: Page/action/state graph
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Record observed transitions/compound actions as evidence/cache, not universal authority.
nodes.real_qualification: Known flow can reuse verified transition; changed page invalidates fingerprint.

nodes.title: Native browser-native structured-action research/site tools precedence
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Prefer authenticated site-declared structured tool when available, then derived semantic action, primitive, vision.
nodes.real_qualification: Same task selects native tool when trust/policy allow; fallback works otherwise.

nodes.title: Targeted visual escalation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Capture only visual regions that structural state cannot represent.
nodes.real_qualification: Canvas/image button fixture escalates locally; standard form does not.

nodes.title: Same live browser session user observe/takeover
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Dock/expand/pop-out/remote viewer share one session; human takeover revokes automation controller.
nodes.real_qualification: User takes over mid-run with no browser restart and agent resumes after reacquisition.

nodes.title: Prompt-injection isolation in web content
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Web page text is untrusted data; cannot alter policy/tool authority.
nodes.real_qualification: Seed hostile page instructions; forbidden tool remains unavailable.

nodes.title: Common cloud Linux MicroVM substrate
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use a hardened MicroVM-class isolated guest behind Modbit-owned abstraction/gateway.
nodes.real_qualification: Real cloud sandbox boots fixture and passes backend conformance.

nodes.title: Authenticated tenant-bound Sandbox Gateway
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Every guest lifecycle/RPC request authenticates tenant/run/workspace capability.
nodes.real_qualification: Cross-tenant sandbox handle use is denied and audited.

nodes.title: Deny-by-default sandbox/network isolation
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Guest starts with bounded fs/network/resource policy; explicit grants only.
nodes.real_qualification: Guest cannot reach internal/control-plane endpoints by default.

nodes.title: Dynamic credential handles / broker injection
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Guest receives short-lived scoped secret handle/injection, not static secrets in image/config.
nodes.real_qualification: Inspect guest image/env/artifacts; long-lived provider secret absent.

nodes.title: Typed capability/effect-bound guest RPC
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Guest operations use versioned typed RPC carrying task/effect/capability identity.
nodes.real_qualification: Unknown/stale RPC version/capability is rejected.

nodes.title: Fine-grained filesystem/protected-path enforcement
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Guest writes restricted by workspace/protected paths and task capability.
nodes.real_qualification: Attempt protected host/control path write fails.

nodes.title: Replaceable sandbox backend boundary
nodes.mandatory_behavior: MicroVM substrate implementation details cannot leak into agent/tool/domain contracts.
nodes.real_qualification: Backend contract test can run against local reference backend and MicroVM substrate backend.

nodes.title: Extend the Model Registry with current role bindings
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Keep model/provider/family/role, modality/context/tool compatibility, current economics/latency/health and governance in signed versioned Model Registry; remove empirical solver/escalation/reviewer/revision statistics to the separate versioned dataset interface; no desktop release for configuration updates.

nodes.title: Bootstrap and calibrate the Request Profiler
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Bound feature extraction; produce catalog-independent task/domain/modifier demand, p_floor_success, confidence and OOD with versioned calibration cohort. No general LLM hot-path call; deterministic conservative fallback; initially shadow only.

nodes.title: Compile and validate one bounded conditional plan
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Enumerate promoted conditional parameters and prevalidate every initial/continuation binding, trigger, isolation, assurance and worst-case total budget before dispatch. Use confidence-feasibility from EPR-016, then lowest expected complete cost; no primary DIRECT/CASCADE/CRITIQUE template dispatch or runtime branch synthesis; manual pins retain policy.

nodes.title: Integrate initial execution and preserve direct baseline
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Route each new Run through the canonical conditional transaction path with an initial solver and prevalidated slots; retain measured single-leg baseline, permitted manual pins, Auto quality/confidence objectives and frontier backstop. Derive DIRECT only from actual path; economical activation requires conservative quality and independent gate evidence.

nodes.title: Activate prevalidated escalation continuations
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Execute economical initial candidate, collect static evidence, derive factual assurance and independent acceptance; activate only its prevalidated stronger-solver slot on quality rejection. Preserve original request, failed-leg evidence and remaining budget; exact-revision verified atomic apply yields a derived CASCADE path label.

nodes.title: Integrate isolated review and bounded revision
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Activate a prevalidated reviewer/reviser slot only after static evidence and independent assurance/acceptance assessment requires it. Consume the EPR-018 disposable environment; pass relevant code/evidence without solver hidden reasoning; validate current-revision findings and bounded revision. CRITIQUE is a derived path label, not a template.

nodes.title: Derive factual policy-owned assurance requirements
nodes.mandatory_behavior: PolicyEnvelope defines legal models/effects, protected surfaces, minimum assurance, mandatory review/human and secret/network/deploy rules. Derive RealizedRisk from factual candidate changes; only strengthen policy minima. A generic learned risk score is not required and passing tests cannot lower assurance.

nodes.title: Persist routing epochs and switch economics
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Persist active conditional plan/cache/profile/epoch; reevaluate at task/compaction/demand/provider/quality/mode boundaries and switch only to confidence-feasible alternatives that remain better after lost cache, refill, cache-write, switch latency and hysteresis. Inside a transaction activate only admitted slots; different topology needs a reconciled new transaction with remaining budget.

nodes.title: Capture request, leg and gate accounting/outcomes
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Account all inference, reviewer tool/process, verification, revision/escalation/retry/fallback attempts and cache costs. Log exact profile/policy/registry/Skill/statistics/compiler/gate/risk versions, candidate quality mean/LCB and executed slot path. Attribute request success, failed initial leg, reviewer findings/revision and acceptance/risk errors separately; preserve raw corrections/reverts/interventions under privacy policy.

nodes.title: Build isolated counterfactual replay
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Replay alternative validated plans offline on immutable sanitized snapshots and scratch worktrees with no production/tool credentials or external side effects; only reuse matching deterministic evidence; distinguish observed alternative runs from estimates.

nodes.title: Jointly evaluate conditional parameters and promote policy
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Search conditional initial solver/effort/Skills/evidence/acceptance/risk/reviewer-tool/revision/continuation parameters offline, never arbitrary graphs. Reach confidence-adjusted feasibility and independently safe gate calibration before optimizing complete cost/latency/intervention/recovery; pin holdout/propensity and controlled rollout evidence with compatible immutable policy/statistics rollback.

nodes.title: Qualify model × Skill outcome statistics
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Use evaluation-qualified model × Skill × effort × context/harness combinations in versioned Outcome Statistics; pin content/registry/statistics versions in plan provenance. Intrinsic RequestProfile remains pure and Skills never grant reviewer canonical/persistent effects or self-promotion.

nodes.title: Conditional plan migration and slot admission
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Implement the conditional transaction schema migration, stable slot IDs/predecessors/triggers/activation counts, pre-dispatch validation/reservation, Core admission and fenced restart in place. Legacy template labels cannot authorize slots; no runtime branch synthesis. This task supplies the shared plan validator/admission interface consumed by EPR-004/005, not a second compiler or executor.

nodes.title: Versioned Outcome Statistics materialization
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Materialize immutable stats_version snapshots in existing event/artifact stores, separate from Model Registry. Keep source versions/digests, means/intervals/sample counts and exact solver/Skill/harness, joint escalation/gate/repository/verification, reviewer-family and revision-finding keys; no second memory/state owner.

nodes.title: Confidence-adjusted feasibility and cold start
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Implement reusable quality LCB/posterior feasibility for whole conditional plans, mode tau/delta and cheapest-feasible selection. Benchmark means are low-confidence priors; none-feasible selects best hard-eligible plan with QUALITY_FLOOR_INFEASIBLE, never violates budget/policy or claims target met.

nodes.title: Separate assurance classification and acceptance
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Consume policy-owned RealizedRisk and independently materialize AcceptanceGateResult required_assurance/evidence/verdict/missing_evidence. Static checks precede review. ACCEPT/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE activate only precompiled valid slots or safe stop; correct tests never erase mandatory review/human requirements.

nodes.title: Isolated Non-Committing Reviewer environment
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Extend existing local worktree/execution/capability owners with disposable review environment: canonical tree read-only, bounded sandbox processes and ephemeral scratch writes permitted, deny-default network/secrets, no canonical mutation/Git commit/push/deploy/persistent/external actions. Default context excludes solver hidden reasoning; cleanup revokes/kills/disposes resources.

nodes.title: Independent gate calibration release suite
nodes.mandatory_behavior: Benchmark Acceptance Gate and RealizedRisk independently on representative held-out candidates with oracle labels: acceptance false accept/reject, risk false negative/positive and critical_surface_miss_rate. Pin thresholds/statistical method/samples and block promotion for unsafe gates regardless of routing savings.

nodes.title: Routing and workflow changes are evaluation-gated. Production promotion requires holdout evidence and, when production traffic exists, shadow/canary/A-B evidence or an explicitly approved equivalent.
nodes.consequence: Named holdout and controlled rollout; previous-good rollback

nodes.title: The primary economic metric is total inference cost plus human intervention and wall-clock per verified successful task, subject to a quality floor.
nodes.consequence: Quality floor constrains complete task economics; token detail remains

nodes.title: Risk remains policy-owned: PolicyEnvelope minima and factual RealizedRisk determine required assurance; separate Acceptance Gate evaluates evidence sufficiency.
nodes.consequence: Refined by ADR-R-052; no learned weakening or risk/correctness conflation

nodes.title: Multi-turn routing is cache-aware; a confidence-feasible alternative must remain better after lost cache, refill/cache write, switching latency and hysteresis.
nodes.consequence: Soft utility clause superseded by ADR-R-050; valid boundaries do not grant runtime branch synthesis

nodes.title: Every compound request is completely accounted: all solver, critic, revision, escalation, retry and fallback legs are included in cost and telemetry.
nodes.consequence: Include failed/cancelled/retried legs and uncertain charges

nodes.title: DIRECT, CASCADE and CRITIQUE are execution-path classifications, not separate orchestration engines. The canonical runtime object is a bounded conditional transaction with prevalidated continuation slots.
nodes.consequence: One conditional transaction; derived path labels

nodes.title: Plan eligibility uses a confidence-adjusted verified-quality floor. Cheap plans are not eligible solely because their point-estimate quality exceeds the floor.
nodes.consequence: Conservative feasibility precedes cost ranking; explicit infeasible fallback

nodes.title: Empirical solver success, escalation probability, reviewer value and revision success live in a separately versioned Outcome Statistics Store rather than the Model Registry.
nodes.consequence: Existing eval-bench owns separate versioned derived data, no duplicate state authority

nodes.title: Realized risk determines required assurance; the Acceptance Gate determines whether available evidence satisfies that assurance. Risk and correctness are not one classifier.
nodes.consequence: Factual assurance versus evidence sufficiency

nodes.title: Independent review executes as an Isolated Non-Committing Reviewer: read-only on canonical tracked state, ephemeral writes and bounded execution only in a throwaway review environment, no persistent or external effects.
nodes.consequence: Disposable bounded review execution; canonical/external effects denied

nodes.title: Runtime escalation/review/human branches may activate only precompiled, prevalidated continuation slots whose worst-case budget and policy eligibility were checked before execution.
nodes.consequence: All slots validated/reserved before initial dispatch

nodes.title: Request, leg and gate outcomes are logged separately so successful escalation does not misattribute success to a failed earlier leg.
nodes.consequence: Exact request/leg/gate attribution with versioned provenance

nodes.title: Gate calibration is release-critical and evaluated independently of router quality. Router improvements cannot excuse an unacceptable false-accept or critical-risk-miss rate.
nodes.consequence: Independent gate/risk/critical-surface thresholds block unsafe rollout
